summary: Core, field and non-economics elective courses must be letter graded, and each core course needs a C or better. ECON 101, or 5 units of ECON 199D, fills both Writing in the Major and the capstone. The major needs 85 units; honors needs 90, at least 2 of them in ECON 199D including the 1-unit winter 199D-20 section, and every quarter of 199D counts toward the 90. Your advisor checks by hand the 2.5 GPA in the major, the electronic portfolio, 200-level or petitioned courses and outside credit (at most 10 units of courses taken elsewhere), and for honors the 3.5 GPA and the thesis.
